description.value: Beach Acres Resort is a family-friendly beachfront resort spread across 23 forested acres in Parksville, BC, bordered by the wide sandy shore of Rathtrevor Beach. Accommodation ranges from beachfront cottages to multi-bedroom oceanview townhouses, all with fully-equipped kitchens. On-site facilities include an indoor heated pool, hot tub, sauna, pickleball and tennis courts, and the historic Black Goose Inn pub-style restaurant.

address.value: 1051 Resort Drive, Parksville, British Columbia, Canada V9P 2E4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich content. The facilities page confirms Wi-Fi and on-site EV chargers; the dining page confirms an on-site restaurant (Black Goose Inn). No bike storage, tools, laundry, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website consistently displays 1.800.663.7309 as the primary phone number, differing from OSM's +1-250-248-3424; the address matches. Recent blog posts dated May 2026 confirm the business is actively operating.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-250-248-3424 but the website consistently and prominently displays 1-800-663-7309 as the primary contact number. The OSM local number may be a secondary/direct line not shown on the website.
Two Stage 2 J1772 EV car chargers are listed in facilities — noted for potential interest but not confirmed usable for e-bike charging, so not counted as e-bike amenity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating beachfront resort with confirmed recent activity (blog posts May 2026) and publicly bookable accommodation on Vancouver Island.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Black Goose Inn: a 60-seat British/Scottish pub-style restaurant offering cocktails, beer, light lunch, and hearty dinner, family-owned since December 2010
